body:
Now: the quest 'New look' pays 40 but clothes cost 60-120. 'Flower power' pays 40 but Flower Shop items cost 30-90. Doing them loses coins.
New: a buy quest pays the cheapest fitting item's price + 20 (New look 80, Flower power 50). Other quests stay.

comments.text: Karolis said 'do the rebalance' in the Schedules and economy chat (30 Oct): approved. Built as a code patch (economy-rebalance.patch, build 2026103101) and checked with the quick kit; goes live through a pull request in the next repo chat.

short: Buy quests never lose you coins
source: chat 2026-10-30: Schedules and economy red team 2
title: Balance 9: daily 'buy' quests never lose you coins
